description: The **minecraft-ai** repository is an AI-powered support agent and procedural 3D asset generation engine built for Craftify Gaming Productions. Featuring a decoupled architecture with a **FastAPI** Python backend and a **Next.js** TypeScript frontend, the platform integrates a hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (**RAG**) engine utilizing **BM25** and **TF-IDF** cosine search across domain documentation. The system features an Agent Intent Router with safety guardrails that processes queries via `POST /ask`, generates custom 3D Minecraft blocks and 16x16 pixel-art PNG textures via `POST /generate_block`, and renders live 3D models using an interactive WebGL viewport. System health metrics are provided via `GET /health`, with full containerization orchestrated using **Docker Compose**.
longDescription:
The **minecraft-ai** system provides a unified solution for automated support Q&A and dynamic 3D Minecraft block asset synthesis. The decoupled frontend layer is constructed with **Next.js 14** and **TypeScript**, presenting a dark console interface complete with response type badges and an interactive WebGL viewer featuring 360-degree orbit controls. The backend API is powered by **FastAPI** on Python, orchestrating query intent routing, document search indexing, and procedural texture/mesh generation.

The core intelligence relies on a dynamic hybrid RAG pipeline that pairs *BM25 keyword search* with *TF-IDF vector cosine similarity* to retrieve grounded citations from Craftify documentation. When a user requests novel blocks—such as a Lava Crystal or Void Portal block—the procedural engine generates custom 16x16 pixel-art PNG textures and Blockbench Java JSON assets, which are rendered client-side in real-time.

An Agent Intent Router governs input processing, determining whether to execute documentation retrieval, run dynamic asset creation tools, or enforce safety guardrails. Execution steps and tool invocations are logged into `tool_calls.json` for auditability. Backend operations are exposed through HTTP endpoints, including `GET /health` for monitoring indexed corpus chunks, `POST /ask` for conversational RAG queries, and `POST /generate_block` for dynamic asset generation.

The deployment topology is fully containerized using **Docker Compose**, coordinating service execution across backend, frontend, and vector database environments. The repository includes an automated evaluation harness (`eval/run_eval.py`) that executes 15 benchmark test queries against golden datasets, ensuring 100% system pass rate verification and safety compliance.

challenges: Balancing precision from lexical BM25 matching with semantic context from TF-IDF vector search in real-time retrieval.
Enforcing strict intent classification guardrails to prevent unauthorized execution of procedural generation tools.
Ensuring deterministic production of valid Blockbench Java JSON geometry and 16x16 pixel-art PNG textures from freeform prompts.
Streaming complex procedural model payloads from FastAPI to the Next.js WebGL viewport without blocking UI responsiveness.
Maintaining high reliability across diverse query types to achieve a 100% pass rate in the benchmark evaluation suite.
learnings: Deep technical patterns in Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js
Effective hybrid search indexing and code chunking for automated AST analysis
Hybrid retrieval systems combining BM25 with vector-based TF-IDF outperform single-technique search when indexing mixed technical and support documentation.
Explicit agent routing states (Answer, Abstention, Tool Call, Guardrail) improve frontend UX by standardizing response badges and citation handling.
Standardizing procedural asset outputs to Blockbench Java JSON ensures seamless compatibility with Minecraft modding conventions.
Automated evaluation harnesses using golden datasets are essential for validating agent safety and intent routing stability during iteration.
Decoupling procedural 3D model generation into dedicated REST endpoints optimizes API throughput and prevents UI thread blocking.
Combining BM25 keyword lookup with TF-IDF cosine similarity significantly improves citation accuracy over simple vector search alone.
Explicit intent routing before tool execution reduces agent hallucinations and enforces safety guardrails.
Generative 3D block synthesis requires synchronized generation of both JSON asset schemas and dynamic texture assets.
Containerizing full-stack agent applications via Docker Compose simplifies local cross-service networking and environment management.
Automated evaluation suites with golden datasets are critical for continuous verification of agent response accuracy.
